# MildDev

> > A comprehensive coding blog covering Python fundamentals, web development, and practical programming tutorials with best practices and real-world examples.

MildDev is a technical blog focused on helping developers master core programming concepts, particularly Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript. The site offers beginner-friendly guides, code tutorials, and best practices across data structures, file I/O, functional programming, and modern development patterns.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Python basics
- Data structures
- Context managers
- Lambda functions
- Decorators
- List comprehension
- JSON handling
- File I/O
- Best practices
- Code examples
- Error handling
- Enumerate
- TypeScript
- Web development

## Python Fundamentals

- [What Are Python Decorators?](https://milddev.com/what-are-python-decorators): Python decorators guide: function wrapping, functools.wraps, design patterns, best practices.
- [Python Context Manager Guide](https://milddev.com/mastering-python-context-managers): Python context managers tutorial: with statement, custom managers, exception handling.
- [What are the differences between Python Modules and Packages?](https://milddev.com/what-are-the-differences-between-python-modules-and-packages): Python modules vs packages: code organization, import system, project structure guide.
- [Python for Loop with Index](https://milddev.com/python-for-loops-with-index): Python loops with index: enumerate(), range(), iteration patterns, clean code tips.
- [How to sort in Python using Lambda](https://milddev.com/how-to-sort-in-python-using-lambda): Python sorting with lambda: sorted(), list.sort(), custom key functions, examples.
- [Python One-Line If Else Statement](https://milddev.com/python-oneline-if-else-statement): Python ternary operator: one-line if-else, list comprehension, readability best practices.

## Data Structures & Collections

- [Adding Elements to Python Sets](https://milddev.com/adding-elements-to-python-sets): Guide to Python sets: add(), update() methods, pitfalls, performance tips with examples.
- [Python Append to Dictionary](https://milddev.com/python-append-to-dictionary): Append to Python dictionaries: update(), setdefault(), defaultdict, unpacking methods.
- [Python Get Index of Item in List](https://milddev.com/python-get-index-of-item-in-list): Get list index in Python: index() method, error handling, enumerate, performance tips.
- [How to Check if a Python List Is Empty](https://milddev.com/how-to-check-if-a-python-list-is-empty): Check empty Python lists: len(), truthiness checks, comparisons, best practices.

## File I/O & Data Handling

- [How to Pretty Print JSON in Python?](https://milddev.com/how-to-pretty-print-json-in-python): Tutorial: pretty print JSON in Python using json module and pprint for readable output.
- [How to save JSON to a Dictionary in python](https://milddev.com/how-to-save-json-to-a-dictionary-in-python): Convert JSON to Python dict: json.loads(), error handling, streaming, performance tips.
- [How to save data to CSV file in python?](https://milddev.com/how-to-save-data-to-a-csv-file-in-python): Save data to CSV in Python: csv.writer, DictWriter, encoding, performance best practices.
- [Python Write String to File](https://milddev.com/how-to-write-a-string-to-a-file-in-python): Python file I/O tutorial: write strings using open(), context managers, encoding.

## Utilities & Tools

- [Python UUID Generator](https://milddev.com/python-uuid-generator): Python UUID generation: uuid module, versions, formatting, best practices, RFC 4122.
